# MileageLogMaker

> MileageLogMaker is a free web tool that builds a mileage log for tax records as a PDF. You enter business, medical and charity trips and each trip is priced at the IRS standard mileage rate for its date, with no signup. A one-time Pro upgrade ($9) removes the PDF watermark and adds Excel and CSV export and your logo. Canadian (CRA) and UK (HMRC) logs are also supported.

IRS standard mileage rates for 2026, as read on irs.gov on November 10, 2026: business 72.5 cents a mile for January 1 to June 30 and 76 cents from July 1; medical and moving 20.5 cents, then 23.5 cents from July 1; charity 14 cents. Every guide names its official source (irs.gov, canada.ca, gov.uk) and the date it was last checked. This is general information, not tax advice.

## Tools

- [Free IRS mileage log generator](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/): Enter trips, get a PDF log with the IRS rate applied by date. Free, no signup.
- [Mileage reimbursement calculator](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/mileage-reimbursement-calculator): Price a list of trips at the IRS rate for each trip date or at an employer's own rate, and download a CSV for Excel.
- [Mileage reimbursement form](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/mileage-reimbursement-form): A printable claim with every trip priced, totals and signature lines.
- [Medical mileage rate and calculator](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/medical-mileage-deduction): The 2026 medical rate by date, what counts as medical travel, parking and tolls, the 7.5% floor, HSA and FSA claims.

## Rates and rules

- [2026 IRS mileage rate](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/mileage-log-2026-irs-rate): 72.5 cents to June 30 and 76 cents from July 1, 2026, with medical, moving and charity rates.
- [IRS mileage rate history](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/irs-mileage-rate-history): Every business, medical or moving, and charity rate from 2011 to 2026.
- [IRS mileage log requirements](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/irs-mileage-log-requirements): What each trip record must show and how the IRS treats a log.
- [How to deduct mileage on taxes](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/how-to-deduct-mileage-on-taxes): Standard rate, what counts as a business mile, records and Schedule C.
- [Standard mileage rate or actual expenses](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/mileage-deduction-vs-actual-expenses): How each method works, when each wins and the first-year rule.
- [Forgot to track mileage](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/forgot-to-track-mileage): What the IRS accepts when a log is missing and how to rebuild one.

## Canada and the UK

- [CRA mileage log book template](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/cra-mileage-log-template): Kilometre logbook, business-use percentage and the simplified logbook.
- [CRA mileage log rules](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/mileage-log-canada): What to record and the 2026 allowance rates.
- [HMRC mileage log](https://www.mileagelogmaker.com/mileage-log-uk): 55p a mile for the first 10,000 business miles from 6 April 2026, then 25p.
